payloads.players: docs/ace/data/<tour>/<year>/players.json -> players{pid}.values / .pct (all surfaces); .values_surface.<surface> / .pct_surface.<surface> (surface groups); data/<tour>/players.json = current year

compare.default: headline set of the tour group (pct); with a surface picked, the surface group's headline (pct_surface, values_surface)
compare.head_to_head: career files players/<pid>.json h2h and results_all give the record; show the two players' headline percentiles side by side for the surface of the next or last meeting

groups.peer_group: ATP players with a tour-level catalogue row in the season; percentiles among the season's qualified players

minimum.note: payload `qualified` = tour-level main-draw matches >= `floor` (20 scaled to the share of the season played, min 8)

metrics.explanation: Overall strength rating from every result, adjusted for the opponent's rating.

similar.standardise: z within tour and season among qualified players; elo_clay and elo_grass enter as (surface Elo - elo) so they describe the surface profile, not the level again
similar.weights: reliability (yoy r; for the surface profile, the yoy r of surface Elo minus Elo), floored at 0.2 and capped at 0.8 for rating and fit metrics whose yoy r is inflated by memory

payload_changes.note: 22 Oct 2026: the surface's Elo (elo_surface, = values.elo_<s>) and the overall Elo (elo) are ranked among the surface pool; surface groups read their Elo percentiles from pct_surface.<s>.<percentile_key>.

22 Oct 2026: win_pct 10 -> 20, games_won_pct 8 -> 12 pseudo-matches (display percentiles only; no model reads them). Dropping tb_pct and dec_pct from the percentile cards is a front-end choice (they are secondary here).

22 Oct 2026: per peer group (all, hard, clay, grass) the group id, minimum, pool size, in_pool, sample, the spec's values (headline ids first), percentiles and ranks for players in the pool, and similar players (tour and surface views, this recipe): the player and compare pages need not load players.json.

elo.name: Elo ratings
elo.about: Our Elo ratings, overall and by surface: each match moves them by how surprising the result was.

serve.name: Serve and return model
serve.about: Serve and return strength inferred from scores against the quality of the opposition, and the hold and break rates they imply.

forecast.name: Match and season forecasts
forecast.about: Our match forecast (Elo blended with the serve and return model) and the rest-of-season simulation: wins against it, projected ranks and chances.
